full_prompt_en: A square digitally processed photographic portrait shows a young man from the chest up against a dark muted teal background. He lowers his head and turns slightly toward the right, looking down from beneath dense curly hair with a serious, inward expression. A textured sweater or knit top enters at the lower edge, its neckline forming a shallow V around the bright throat. The face, neck, and shoulders remain recognizable, but red and cyan image channels are deliberately offset. A saturated red duplicate follows the left edge of the head and shoulder, while vivid cyan traces the nose, cheek, neck, and chest in broad luminous patches. Yellow appears where the colors overlap near the center of the face and collarbone. The right side of the face has a strong red edge, and deep shadow almost hides the opposite eye. Tiny colored speckles in the hair and sweater make the registration shift visible at the finest scale. The background stays comparatively smooth and empty so the dislocated outline reads clearly. Lighting is dramatic from the front-right or above, yet the perceived brightness comes as much from color-channel separation as from natural illumination. Hard dark shadows hold the center of the head, while the cyan and red rims make the silhouette vibrate. The close crop, subdued setting, and unstable doubled edges give the quiet pose an uneasy, three-dimensional graphic energy.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形数字处理过的摄影人像在深暗柔青绿背景前呈现一位年轻男子的胸部以上。他低头略向右转，从浓密卷发下向下看，神情严肃内敛。带纹理的针织上衣从下缘进入，领口在明亮喉部周围形成浅 V 形。面孔、颈部和肩膀仍清楚可辨，但红色与青色图像通道被刻意错开。饱和红色副影沿头和肩的左缘延伸，鲜亮青蓝以宽阔发光斑块描出鼻子、脸颊、颈部与胸前。颜色在面孔中央和锁骨附近重叠时出现黄色。脸的右侧有强烈红边，深影几乎藏住另一只眼睛。头发和针织衫里的细小彩色颗粒让最小尺度的套印错位也可见。背景相对平滑而空旷，使移位轮廓清楚。光从右前或上方戏剧性地照来，但可见亮度很大程度也来自色通道分离，而非自然照明。硬朗深影撑住头部中央，青红边光使剪影振动。近裁切、低调环境和不稳定的双重边缘使安静姿态带着令人不安的立体图形能量。
style_prompt_en: Anaglyph-like photographic treatment separates red and cyan channels around otherwise legible forms. Deep teal and charcoal occupy broad quiet areas, while electric cyan, saturated red, and narrow yellow overlaps define focal edges. Slightly displaced duplicates and fine colored speckles make contours vibrate, especially in textured regions. Dark directional shading provides volume beneath the color effect, preventing the image from becoming a flat outline. A simple uncluttered ground allows the channel shifts to carry the composition. Close framing, asymmetric color halos, and strong local contrast create a tense, altered-depth sensation.
style_prompt_zh: 类似红青立体影像的摄影处理在仍可辨的形体周围分离红与青色通道。深青绿与炭灰占据宽阔安静区域，电青、饱和红及狭窄黄色重叠处限定焦点边缘。轻微移位的副影与细小彩色颗粒使轮廓振动，尤其在纹理区域。深色定向阴影在色彩效果下提供体积，避免图像变成平面描边。简净无物的底色让色通道错位承担构图。近景框取、非对称色晕与强局部反差制造紧张的变形纵深感。
theme_en: A downward-looking portrait with red-cyan anaglyph separation
theme_zh: 红青立体错位效果中的低头人像
name: Anaglyph colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
